text: Before dispatching any job whose reading touches prompt files, work out the token headroom of every prompt set that includes each target file. Use the same figure the budgets test prints. Add that headroom to the reading, and refuse the reading (or move the edit to a file used by fewer sets) when the planned addition is bigger than the smallest headroom. Also give the producer the scoped budgets test command so it can check prompt sizes without the full suite. Done means a test shows that a reading which adds text to a prompt set already near its limit is refused before dispatch.
